Public Function Probe(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As Worksheet, r As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set s = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.Shapes.Count) & " " & s.Shapes.Count & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.Shapes(1).Name) & " " & s.Shapes(1).Name & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.Shapes(1).Type) & " " & s.Shapes(1).Type & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.Shapes(1).HasChart) & " " & s.Shapes(1).HasChart & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.Shapes(2).Name) & " " & s.Shapes(2).Name & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects.Count) & " " & s.ChartObjects.Count & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Name) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Name & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Name) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Name & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.ChartType) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.ChartType & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection.Count) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Name) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Name & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasTitle) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasTitle & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasLegend) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasLegend & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.ChartType) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.ChartType & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection.Count) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).TopLeftCell.Address) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).TopLeftCell.Address & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).TopLeftCell.Address) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).TopLeftCell.Address & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasAxis(1)) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasAxis(1) & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasAxis(2)) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.HasAxis(2) & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.ChartGroups(1).VaryByCategories) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.ChartGroups(1).VaryByCategories & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).InvertIfNegative) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).InvertIfNegative & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).MarkerStyle) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).MarkerStyle & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Smooth) & " " & s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Smooth & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.HasAxis(1)) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.HasAxis(1) & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.HasAxis(2)) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.HasAxis(2) & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.ChartGroups(1).VaryByCategories) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.ChartGroups(1).VaryByCategories & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).InvertIfNegative) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).InvertIfNegative & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).MarkerStyle) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).MarkerStyle & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    Err.Clear
    r = r & TypeName(s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Smooth) & " " & s.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Smooth & " " & Err.Number & "|"
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Probe = r
End Function

Public Function Moved(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set s = wb.Worksheets(1)
    s.Rows(1).Insert
    Moved = s.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
End Function
